family_contract.entry_rule: After completed lookback selloff, simple RSI, bullish prior-high and session-VWAP reclaim gates, enter the ranked symbol at the next observed one-minute open.
family_contract.exit_rule: Resolve the frozen raw-R target or stop with stop-first same-minute ambiguity and otherwise force flat at the 15:50 bar open.
family_contract.expected_holding_behavior: Long only, next-minute entry, and flat by 15:50 ET on the signal day.
family_contract.material_difference_rationale: This exact replication preserves the complete 32-trial development grid and inspected 100-signal 2023-2024 corpus while binding a separately inspected 40-session completed reserve whose target scanner inputs stop at 09:35 ET.
family_contract.mechanism: Intraday mean reversion after a completed short-horizon oversold selloff inside a point-in-time liquid opening-gap common-stock universe.
family_contract.primary_outcome: Selection-adjusted chronological account log growth after costs.
production_compatibility_risks: Live completeness of the 09:35 gap universe, fresh quote, spread, depth, halt, tradability, timing, protection, and reconciliation remain mandatory.
family_contract.ranking_rule: Earliest next-minute entry, then deepest selloff, lowest RSI, and lexical symbol.
family_contract.selection_rule: At most one new family entry per day under the authoritative portfolio risk, notional, entry, and capital-contention caps.
family_contract.stop_rule: Use the lowest completed session low through the trigger bar; a nonpositive structural stop produces a missed trade.
